column1: # The secrets a machine needs to deploy and operate this portfolio without a
# GitHub Actions runner. Tab-separated: name, what it gates, where it comes from.
# WHAT BELONGS HERE, AND WHAT DOES NOT
# This is not an inventory of every Actions secret. It is the set that a laptop,
# a Cursor automation, or a local Claude Code session has to be able to read in
# order to get the catalogue in front of a stranger — the routes in
# infra/SECRETS.md. A credential only a workflow ever uses (the four reviewer
# GitHub Apps, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, the Vercel trio, DOCS_PASSCODE) stays in
# Actions, because moving it here would widen the blast radius of the local
# store for no gain: nothing off-runner can use it.
# `bootstrap/scripts/load-secrets.sh` reads column 1 and prints column 2 for
# anything missing. gitops/tests/test_load_secrets.py asserts this file and
# infra/SECRETS.md name the same secrets, so the doc cannot drift from the tool.
# name
HETZNERSSHKEY
column2: SSH to both boxes — the cluster restore, the host-mode site, every runner-free route
column3: the private half of the key already installed on root@89.167.29.39 and root@157.180.80.188. The Actions secret of this name holds the PUBLIC half (run 33884253173) and has never opened a session.

column1: ARGOCD_REPO_TOKEN
column2: Argo CD cloning this private GitOps repo; without it the restore succeeds and the site stays dark
column3: fine-grained PAT, this repo, Contents: Read. The same token seals portfolio-site-repo.

column1: GH_TOKEN
column2: the agents identity — opening PRs, reading CI, the Codex worker
column3: fine-grained PAT per infra/OWNER_CHECKLIST.md (Contents, Pull requests, Issues: RW; Administration, Secrets, Workflows off)

column1: HCLOUD_TOKEN
column2: preflight, `make discover`, `tofu plan` — read-only by policy
column3: Hetzner Cloud API token, Read only. Same value as the HETZNERREADAPIKEY Actions secret. Never store a write token here.

column1: RUNNER_TOKEN
column2: registering the host-mode GitHub Actions runner (gitops/ci/host) — unmetered CI
column3: fine-grained PAT, this repo, Administration: Read and write

column1: CODEX_AUTH_JSON
column2: the Codex worker's dev capacity (gitops/agents/host), on the ChatGPT plan's INCLUDED quota — a tick costs nothing extra
column3: the whole ~/.codex/auth.json after `codex login` on a machine where you are signed in. Prefer this to OPENAI_API_KEY below: worker.sh picks it first and withholds the API key when both are present, so storing only this one cannot bill.

column1: OPENAI_API_KEY
column2: the Codex worker's dev capacity (gitops/agents/host) — the METERED fallback, billed per token
column3: an OpenAI project API key, not an Admin key. Only needed if you have no ChatGPT plan to draw on; set a hard project spend limit first.
